package.description: Run commands with merged env files and proxy management

en-US.description: Run commands with merged env files and proxy management
en-US.longDescription:
runx is a command proxy utility that executes commands with merged environment files.
It can register command proxies and shell functions, supports Windows/Linux workflows,
and resolves envfiles from the current directory tree and home directory.
en-US.name: runx
